description: Only for the Awning team. Enquiries from the business page of the website (awning.help/business): someone left an email, with a business name when they gave one. By default it lists the new ones; status=converted lists those who went on to fill the questionnaire. Use it to see who asked to join; then op_decide_lead. Not for applications that are already filled in (op_applications).

status.description: Which enquiries: new (the default), contacted (invited), converted (filled in the questionnaire) or closed
